days.title: Python Program Structure
days.summary: How the simulator starts: modules, imports, __name__, main(), SystemExit, argparse, logging.

days.title: Protocol and State
days.summary: JSON command/response protocols, sequence IDs, validation, error codes — and adding a command test-first.

days.title: TCP Server
days.summary: Sockets, loopback, streams, request handlers, encoding, malformed input.

days.title: Client Engineering
days.summary: LabClient: connection state, timeouts, buffered readers, monotonic timing, error translation, context managers.

days.title: pytest Fundamentals
days.summary: Discovery, assertions, fixtures, scopes, parametrization, markers, failure output.

days.title: Process Lifecycle Automation
days.summary: subprocess.Popen, readiness polling, terminate/wait/kill, yield fixtures, orphan risk.

days.title: Requirements and Evidence
days.summary: requirement → test → execution → result → evidence: markers, CSVs, JUnit, logs.

days.title: Fault Injection
days.summary: Config-driven faults in the DUT; classifying product vs test vs infrastructure vs configuration failures.

days.title: Concurrency and Timing
days.summary: Threads, concurrent clients, shared state, races, locks, deterministic tests.

days.title: CI/CD
days.summary: Pipelines, jobs, runners, artifacts, quality gates, and what evidence survives a failing check.

days.title: C++ DUT
days.summary: The same protocol in C++: headers and translation units, RAII ownership, CMake, CTest, and one harness driving either implementation. Needs a C++ toolchain.

days.title: Native Debugging
days.summary: Controlled C++ failures — crash, bad access, deadlock, slow response — read with GDB backtraces and live thread dumps. Needs a C++ toolchain and gdb.

days.title: Simulation and HWIL Reasoning
days.summary: Transferable test-architecture: stimulus, DUT, telemetry, fault insertion, shared bench resources.

days.title: Capstone and Interview Mode
days.summary: Diagnose an unfamiliar injected failure end-to-end; interview drilling on weak concepts.
